name: listing-lens-docs
description: Private Listing Lens documentation site (Next.js on Cloudflare Pages + Access)

scripts.//pages:deploy: Verification is chained here too. This script bypasses the workflow, and the workflow is where the Access gate is applied and proven — a manual deploy that skipped the check would put the site back in the state this whole control exists to catch.
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=listing-lens-docs --branch=main && DOCS_HOSTNAME=listing-lens-docs.pages.dev bash scripts/verify-access-gate.sh
